name: Telegram Notification 0.6.0
description: Send finished videos to Telegram via MTProto (files over 50 MB and HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies supported). Posts the video only by default — no text at all; the text caption and the cover image each have their own switch. Can create/reuse one group forum topic per model and post the video into it. Uses your signed-in account by default: it can list existing topics (no duplicates) and files over 2 GB are sent as numbered video parts. Supports multiple user sessions: when the current account is upload-throttled, the next signed-in account is used and the file is re-uploaded

account.label: Login mode (auto = your signed-in account wins / user = your account only / bot = bot account only)

session_label.label: Current session label (blank = primary {api_id}_user.db; enter a label such as backup1 when signing in another account)

fallback_sessions.label: Backup session labels (comma separated, e.g. backup1,backup2. On FLOOD_WAIT / FLOOD_PREMIUM_WAIT the next signed-in account is tried and the whole file is re-uploaded)

api_hash.label: API Hash (bot accounts only — leave empty for a user account)

chat_id.label: Chat ID (groups and supergroups: -100xxxxxxxxxx; a private group has no username, so the id is the only way to target it)

username.label: Group username (optional — public groups only, e.g. mygroupname, without @; leave empty for private groups and use Chat ID)

send_caption.label: Attach a text caption (model name, timestamp, duration, file name, size). With this off the message carries no text at all — just the video

send_cover.label: Also send the cover image (a frame extracted from the video). With this off the album holds the video only

cover_first.label: Upload the cover first; once the video upload finishes, post the cover as its own message before the video. With this off the cover and the video go out together as one album message

topic_per_model.label: Create/reuse a group topic per model and upload into it

delete_after_send.label: Delete local data after a successful send (video, segments, metadata and module side files) to free server space

upload_workers.label: Concurrent upload parts (default 16, max 16; 0 = default). Serial uploads wait for the server to acknowledge every 512KB part; running several at once overlaps those round trips — a 12MB video measured ~1.8x faster (the uplink itself is the ceiling)

upload_engine.label: Upload engine (wzgram = fast WZGram uploader / grammers = built-in Rust uploader). WZGram reuses the signed-in session and falls back to Rust on failure
